summary: Iteration 38 — RadioLife.app rebrand + Promoted stations (CPM/CPC) + News live fallback + demo-login geo/session fix. Backend pytest 7/7 pass (news headlines/breaking populate via NewsAPI fallback with correct public shape; /api/promoted/stations seeds sponsored cards with is_sponsored/promo_id/pricing_model/sponsor_name; impression + click increment counters, CPC accrues, bad promo_id -> 404; POST /api/auth/demo returns non-'BigFM Demo Listener' name + session_token + market from geo). Mobile Expo web preview: 'Try the demo' logs in and lands on /home (no infinite splash); Home wordmark = 'RadioLife.app'; welcome shows 'Demo' + 'DIL SE · DALLAS SE' (geo-resolved market — pod egresses in US so market=dfw); BREAKING banner shows live NewsAPI headline; TOP PLAYED STATIONS + MOST PLAYED LIVE STATIONS square rails render; first two tiles carry 'SPONSORED' tag (Talk 100.3 UAE, Luv 107.1 UAE); FunAsia footer link visible. Mobile News tab renders live headlines (BBC/TMZ/WSJ/CBS). Mobile /stations Browse shows 'SPONSORED STATIONS' pinned header + Sponsored rows; Genre chip 'Bollywood' now correctly filters — total count changed from '2,012 live stations' to '261 live stations' (category param wired). Web LandingV2 (/l/v2) shows 'RadioLife.app' wordmark + tappable [data-testid=funasia-footer-link] pointing to https://funasianetwork.com. Web '/' (RootGate -> MarketingShell) still shows 'RadioLife.AI' wordmark and has no funasia footer link — outside AppShell + LandingV2 scope but flagged as branding inconsistency.

issues: Wordmark still reads 'RadioLife.AI' (top-nav + '© 2026 RadioLife AI Radio' footer) while LandingV2 and mobile use 'RadioLife.app'. No funasianetwork.com footer link on MarketingShell. Review scope was AppShell + LandingV2 so not a blocker, but worth aligning MarketingShell too for a single brand voice. Reference: /app/frontend/src/marketing/MarketingShell.jsx:186 ('© {year} RadioLife AI Radio').

Multiple external station logos are served over http:// (e.g. cdn-profiles.tunein.com) and are auto-upgraded by the browser with mixed-content warnings. Non-blocking but noisy in console; consider proxying or rewriting to https at ingest time.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated in React Native Web — use 'boxShadow'. Repeated console warning on load. Reference: search /app/mobile for shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Console warning after tapping demo login. Reference: search /app/mobile for pointerEvents={ prop usage.

parity_issues.issue: Anonymous '/' MarketingShell still says 'RadioLife.AI' instead of the shared 'RadioLife.app' used by mobile Home and LandingV2.
parity_issues.expected: Both web surfaces (MarketingShell + LandingV2 + AppShell) and mobile all show 'RadioLife.app'.

action_items: LOW: Align MarketingShell wordmark + footer to 'RadioLife.app' and add a funasianetwork.com link there too (matches AppShell/LandingV2/mobile). File: /app/frontend/src/marketing/MarketingShell.jsx.
LOW: Replace deprecated shadow* RN style props with boxShadow across mobile styles to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
LOW: Replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents in mobile RN components.
OPTIONAL: Rewrite mixed-content station logos (http://cdn-profiles.tunein.com…) to https at Radio-Browser ingest time to eliminate mixed-content warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: NEWS fallback in routes/news_phase_r.py._fetch_live_headlines silently returns [] on any exception — good defensive behavior, but consider a WARN log so a real NewsAPI outage isn't invisible.

promoted_stations.ensure_promoted_seed seeds only when collection is empty; if all promos are later marked active=false the empty-active rail cannot be re-seeded without manual intervention. Consider seeding when count of active promos == 0 instead.

auth.demo_login geo-updates market/city but does NOT overwrite name back to DEMO_NAME on re-login — the always-set 'name': DEMO_NAME in set_fields handles this (good). Confirmed name != 'BigFM Demo Listener'.
MOCKED: promoted stations spend accrual is accounting-only (spend_cents on promo doc). No wallet/Stripe settlement. Called out in the module docstring — matches the review's 'MOCKED billing' note.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of spec items verified on mobile + LandingV2; one out-of-scope MarketingShell branding gap flagged

test_credentials: Mobile: tap 'Try the demo' (data-testid=demo-login-btn). No password required. Backend test helper: POST /api/auth/_demo_reset_rate_limit resets the demo rate bucket.
seed_data_creation: GET /api/promoted/stations auto-seeded 3 promo docs from flagship imported stations on first call (idempotent; leaves data behind for regression runs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 7/7 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter38_radiolife.py cover the full scope (news fallback, promoted stations lifecycle, demo-login geo). Mobile: everything in the review passes. Web: LandingV2 (/l/v2) fully matches the review; MarketingShell at '/' still uses old 'RadioLife.AI' branding — flagged as parity issue, main agent to align if desired. Screenshots at /tmp/*iter38*.png. NewsAPI live fallback is real network — a NewsAPI outage will make TestNewsFallback tests fail with 0 items.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Prior iter37 issues (missing TOP PLAYED rail and non-working Genre filter) are both fixed: TOP PLAYED STATIONS + MOST PLAYED LIVE STATIONS both render on mobile Home; Genre chip 'Bollywood' cuts station count 2012 -> 261 confirming category param + useCallback deps are wired.
